description: This PHP script defines a class 'CustomerGroup' within the OpenCart platform, specifically for managing customer groups through various admin tasks such as listing, generating JSON files, and clearing data related to customer groups.

classes.name: CustomerGroup
classes.description: Controller class for managing customer groups within the OpenCart admin panel, providing methods to list, detail, and clear customer group data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes task list for customer group management by adding clear and list tasks.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Generates a JSON list of customer groups, saves it to a file, and creates tasks for each customer group.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Generates detailed information for a specific customer group, including custom field data, and saves it as a JSON file.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes generated JSON files related to customer groups.
